title: Purifying Wind

outfit_card.silhouette: Layered two-piece desert-temple couture with a cropped draped blouse, ornate golden waist cincher, and a voluminous, asymmetrical split-front skirt with thigh-high slit and sweeping sash.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: White sheer veil headdress with gold-banded edge, beaded forehead chain, and dangling turquoise and gold earrings; no hair color defined.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Sheer white draped organza blouse with cowl neckline, layered gold collar necklace set with turquoise cabochons, ornate gold filigree arm cuffs and wrist bangles, short cap sleeves with hanging gold beads.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Asymmetrical layered skirt with dark burgundy velvet panels, sheer red and gold leaf-patterned silk tiers, knife pleats, and a high thigh slit; gold chain belt with turquoise clasp, bare legs with gold anklets, and red-gold strappy sandals.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Floating golden feather and leaf motifs, a glowing circular halo ring behind the back, drifting translucent light veils, and a handheld ceremonial wind staff.
